propositions: Single isolated voter error marker within a 5-minute window currently triggers alarm paging despite being self-healing and designed to recover automatically

Recalibrate alarm from 1-of-1 evaluation period (Sum>0) to 3-of-5 datapoints_to_alarm shape to distinguish transient self-healing errors from sustained voter failure modes like expired tokens or LLM outage

A sustained voter failure produces continuous marker emissions across consecutive evaluation periods due to webhook queue and backfill reconciler retry loops, requiring alarm discrimination based on persistence rather than magnitude

Alarm must remain deaf to isolated transient markers that clear within one or two period boundaries but fire within approximately 15 minutes when markers persist across three or more of five consecutive 300-second periods
